# Hermes Agency

Hermes Agency is a Hermes Agent plugin and local operations layer for running a managed multi-agent team. It installs and coordinates specialist `agency-*` Hermes profiles, routes work by skill, tracks execution through Kanban when available, manages model-set strategies, exposes Hermes CLI/slash/model-tool surfaces, and delegates work over the primary Keryx P2P transport.

Hermes Agency is the product in this repository. Keryx is the primary transport and its Python SDK is vendored at `src/keryx/` (import name `keryx`). AgentAnycast remains under `src/agentanycast/` as legacy/fallback compatibility only.

## Primary capabilities

- Packaged specialist staff roster under `hermes-agency/default_staff/`
- Per-profile AgentCards built from `SOUL.md`, installed skills, and non-secret config metadata
- Per-profile node lifecycle and task queue management
- Skill-based discovery and task sending through Keryx
- Safe incoming task handling with conservative defaults
- Kanban-aware task routing and reconciliation when Hermes Kanban is available
- Team/orchestrator context injection through Hermes plugin hooks
- Model-set management for bulk provider/model strategy changes
- Orchestrator-only `orch_*` tools for promoted agency coordinators
- Headless Docker setup/node runtime

## Important command surfaces

Standalone package command:

```bash
hermes-agency doctor
hermes-agency status --extended
hermes-agency staff list
hermes-agency staff install --dry-run
hermes-agency models list
hermes-agency models plan <model-set>
hermes-agency setup-plugins
hermes-agency start
hermes-agency registry
hermes-agency discover <skill>
```

Hermes Agent plugin CLI after the plugin is loaded:

```bash
hermes agency status
hermes agency start
hermes agency stop
hermes agency discover <skill>
hermes agency registry
hermes agency doctor
```

Hermes session slash command:

```text
/agency status
/agency start
/agency stop
/agency discover <skill>
/agency registry
/agency doctor
```

Model tool names use the `agency_*` prefix. Legacy `a2a_*` tool names may exist as deprecated compatibility aliases.

## Docker

The current Docker compose setup is headless. It runs setup and/or the local agency node manager; it is not a dashboard service.

```bash
docker compose up --build
docker compose --profile tools run --rm setup
docker compose --profile split up node
```

Useful environment variables:

```bash
HERMES_AGENCY_MODEL_SET=<model-set>
HERMES_AGENCY_START_NODE=0
HERMES_AGENCY_ALLOW_REMOTE_TASKS=0
HERMES_AGENCY_TOOL_ACCESS=safe
HERMES_KERYX_DAEMON_ENDPOINT=<daemon-endpoint>
HERMES_KERYX_RELAY_ENDPOINT=<relay-endpoint>
HERMES_KERYX_REGISTRY_ENDPOINT=<registry-address>
```

`AGENTANYCAST_RELAY` and `AGENTANYCAST_REGISTRY_ADDRS` are legacy fallback variables, not the primary Keryx path.

## Configuration shape

Hermes profile config:

```yaml
plugins:
  enabled:
    - agency

agency:
  enabled: true
  transport_backend: keryx
  auto_start: false
  allow_remote_tasks: false
  keryx:
    daemon_endpoint: <daemon-endpoint>
    relay_endpoint: <relay-endpoint>
    registry_endpoint: <registry-address>
  incoming:
    mode: delegation
    tool_access: safe
  team:
    auto_discover: true
    kanban_integration: true
    inject_context: true
  models:
    active_set: <model-set>
  orchestrator:
    enabled: false
    agent: null
    auto_decompose: true
```

Keryx config maps to `HERMES_KERYX_DAEMON_ENDPOINT`, `HERMES_KERYX_RELAY_ENDPOINT`, `HERMES_KERYX_REGISTRY_ENDPOINT`, `HERMES_KERYX_WORKER_ID`, `HERMES_KERYX_DEFAULT_LEASE_DURATION_MS`, and `HERMES_KERYX_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS`; the vendored SDK also accepts the shorter `KERYX_*` aliases.

## Transport layer

`src/keryx/` contains the vendored Python SDK used by Hermes Agency's primary transport. It provides:

- `KeryxNode` gRPC client wrapper for `keryxd`
- AgentCards and skills
- peer identity / DID helpers
- direct and skill-based task sending
- A2A-style task payloads and task handles
- encrypted relay/registry-backed peer transport through external Keryx runtime services

Most operators should use Hermes Agency commands/tools instead of the raw transport API. Modify `src/keryx/` only for Keryx SDK work, and modify `src/agentanycast/` only for explicit legacy fallback fixes.

## Safety boundaries

- Remote task execution defaults to disabled: `allow_remote_tasks: false`.
- Incoming remote-task tools should default to `safe`, not `full`.
- Plugin discovery should not start daemons when Agency is disabled or transport dependencies are unavailable.
- Do not expose API keys, raw environment variables, local paths, private relay addresses, real peer IDs, private hostnames, Discord channel IDs, gateway logs, or maintainer-local details in docs, AgentCards, logs, tests, or fixtures.
- Management endpoints and local services should be loopback-only unless explicit remote/LAN mode is configured.
- State-changing HTTP endpoints must require authentication.
- Auto-update flows should verify trusted signed commits before applying changes.

## Development checks

```bash
ruff check .
ruff format --check .
make test-agency
make test-sdk
python -m pytest
python -m pip check
```

Manual/live checks:

```bash
make integration-agency
make integration-agency-full
```
